The '''Corbett Cluster''' was a [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]] in the [[Corbett sector/Legends|Corbett sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was protected by the [[Solar Guard]] during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]].
